messages:
Priya (Sales): Heads up 7 Solstice Labs wants to move from POC -> Dedicated commit. Ask: 6mo reserved pool, mixed GPUs (3 A100 + 3 H100), plus a short ramp period where they can burst 2x baseline for testing (first 14 days). They're asking for a one-time onboarding credit of 15% applied to month1. Deal = D-4907. Need deal-desk + finance + legal ok.

Ethan (Solutions): POC logs show steady 200 concurrent tokens/sec with 450 peaks on heavy transforms. My recommended pool: min=2, target=5, max=8, burst policy "test-ramp-2x" limited to 14days and to specific hours. Sample config: 
```
pool: solstice-commit-01
min: 2
target: 5
max: 8
gpus: {a100-80:3, h100-80:3}
autoscale_policy: test-ramp-2x
burst_window: 02:00-08:00 UTC (customer local testing)
burst_duration_limit: 14 days
```

Ethan (Solutions): Also note we should pin fallback model to reduce quality variance if H100 capacity not available.

Ravi (Finance): 15% one-time credit on month1 is borderline: discounts >=15% require VP approval per discount policy. If Sales wants to avoid escalation, propose 10% onboarding credit + 5% usage credit spread over months 1-3. Need committed GPU-hours forecast to model cashflow. Also confirm billing cadence (monthly invoice vs upfront prepay).

Priya (Sales): They prefer monthly billing to preserve cash flexibility. Customer is ok with a small up-front deposit but not full prepay. I'll ask them to accept monthly invoice + deposit.

Nina (EngOps): Ops constraints: region us-west-2 currently has limited spare H100 capacity. We cannot guarantee 2x burst if other customers spike. Need explicit fallback: either route to another region (latency risk) or fallback to A100-only variant. I'll open RED-3333 to track runbook + region capacity anchor. Also recommend max burst nodes = 7 to avoid overcommit.

Carl (Legal): For 15% credit and burst carve-out we need SOW addendum: define "burst" as best-effort, list fallback behavior, and include credit recoup on early termination (pro-rated). Discounts >=15% need legal + finance signoff. I can draft the addendum; expect first pass tomorrow.

Priya (Sales): Proposed commercial terms to present to customer: 6-month commit, monthly billing, deposit = 10% of month1 invoice, onboarding credit 10% applied to month1 + 5% usage credit spread months 2-3 (total 15%), burst policy limited to 14 days with defined fallback (A100-only or region failover). Can Finance + Legal confirm?

Ravi (Finance): I can accept that split (10% upfront deposit, 10% month1 credit, 5% spread) without VP escalation. Still need committed GPU-hours by month and expected burst-hours for the 14-day window. I'll produce a worksheet once we have those numbers.

Carl (Legal): OK on the split. I will add language about "best-effort burst" + fallback routing to the SOW addendum and include a credit clawback clause if they terminate mid-commit. Draft by EOD tomorrow.

Ethan (Solutions): I'll upload the forecast and the evals (pinned fallback model + quantization profile) to the deal folder now. Also attaching a short README for their SREs on autoscale knobs.

invoicing-bot: Note: Enter onboarding credit as invoice line item using discount code SALESPROC-D4907-ONB. Any credit >10% must be routed through VP approvals in finance UI. Deposit should be created as "prepayment" line with memo D-4907.

Priya (Sales): Next steps: 1) Ethan uploads committed GPU-hour forecast (doing now). 2) Ravi prepares finance worksheet. 3) Carl drafts SOW addendum. 4) Nina + EngOps finalize RED-3333 runbook. 5) Submit deal-desk form after internal approvals. Tagging D-4907. :white_check_mark:

Priya (Sales): If anyone needs a quick sync I'm free at 3pm today to walk the customer terms before I send the proposal.
